command.tellCopilot: Give the session to the AI agent
config.autoPush: Push the sketch (.ino, .h, .cpp of its folder) to the lab's bench on each save, while a session is open.
color.statusBarForeground: Colour of the Picodev Lab status bar item while a session is open.
config.arduinoCli: Path of `arduino-cli`, to compile the sketch on your machine. Empty: `arduino-cli` on the PATH, else the one bundled with the Arduino extension. Without it, the lab compiles the sketch.
config.git: Offer a local git repo for the sketch when a session opens, and commit after each successful push. Nothing is pushed to a git host.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Picodev Lab
walkthrough.description: A simulated Arduino bench in your browser, programmed by an AI agent: Claude Code or Copilot.
walkthrough.folder.title: Open a folder with your sketch
walkthrough.folder.description:
Picodev Lab sends the sketch of your folder (an .ino file, with its .h and .cpp). No sketch yet? Create a starter one.
[Open a folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
[Create a starter sketch](command:picodevLab.starter)
walkthrough.folder.alt: A click on Open a folder: the explorer shows sketch.ino and the editor its code.
walkthrough.session.title: Open a session
walkthrough.session.description:
Pick a setup: a board and the parts wired to it, simulated. A challenge gives you levels with tests; a free session lets you program as you wish.
[Open a challenge](command:picodevLab.challenge)
[Open a session](command:picodevLab.open)
walkthrough.session.alt: A setup is picked in the list; its board appears and the LEDs wired to it light up.
walkthrough.bench.title: Keep the bench open in your browser
walkthrough.bench.description:
The bench is the lab's page that runs the simulation: it opens with the session, and must stay open while you work.
[Open the bench](command:picodevLab.openBench)
walkthrough.bench.alt: The lab's page in a browser tab: the simulated board's LED blinks and pin 13's signal scrolls.
walkthrough.copilot.title: Give the session to the AI agent
walkthrough.copilot.description:
The extension prefills the agent's chat with the session: Claude Code (with the picodev-lab plugin) when it is installed, else Copilot in Agent mode. Send the message: the agent writes the code, compiles it and drives the bench through the lab's tools. Setting: Picodev Lab › Agent.
[Give it to the agent](command:picodevLab.tellCopilot)
walkthrough.copilot.alt: The agent's chat is prefilled, then sent: the agent writes the code, sends the program and reads the simulation.
walkthrough.compile.title: Compile on your machine (optional)
walkthrough.compile.description:
With arduino-cli installed, the sketch is compiled on your machine and only the program is sent; without it, the lab compiles it.
[Install arduino-cli](https://arduino.github.io/arduino-cli/latest/installation/)
[Set its path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22picodevLab.arduinoCli%22%5D)
walkthrough.compile.alt: arduino-cli compiles the sketch in the terminal; only the program (HEX) goes to the lab.
config.agent: The AI agent that gets the session, the fixes and the project interview.
config.agent.auto: Claude Code when it is installed, else Copilot.
config.agent.claude: Claude Code, with the lab's MCP server (the extension offers to add it).
